mechanism_narrative: The persistent week-over-week rise in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES means commuting and workplace activity are recovering from the pandemic trough, which mechanically increases weekday retail-and-recreation footfall over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to its mean over the last 28 days despite TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improving for the four weeks ending 2021-09-15.

mechanism_narrative: When the TRANSIT weekly mean crosses above -70.0, it signals policy easing and restored transit capacity, which lowers the cost of out-of-home activity and lifts retail-and-recreation mobility over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean rises above -70.0 (less negative than -70.0).
failure_condition: After TRANSIT crosses above -70.0, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days does not exceed its mean over the prior 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: As RESIDENTIAL mobility falls and PARKS mobility rises, residents shift from staying home to out-of-home activity, and this behavioral normalization drives higher discretionary retail-and-recreation visits over four weeks.
failure_condition: When RESIDENTIAL declines and PARKS rises, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than its mean over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: In an explicit reopening regime where GROCERY_PHARM has improved above -6.0, essential-trip normalization reduces perceived risk and increases retail-and-recreation mobility over the next week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM weekly mean is greater than -6.0 (less negative).
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM is greater than -6.0 but RETAIL_REC in the following week does not exceed its last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Post-monsoon and pre-festive season demand in Delhi raises shopping and recreation demand, so modest mobility recovery translates into higher RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than its mean over the last 28 days despite the pre-festive seasonal window.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in RESIDENTIAL mobility below 21.5 signals reduced at-home caution, and this behavioral release drives retail-and-recreation trips upward over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL falls below 21.5 but mean RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than its mean over the prior 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: Recovery in WORKPLACES mobility re-establishes commuting and lunchtime routines that directly increase weekday retail-and-recreation footfall over the next week.
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES weekly mean is above -40.0 but RETAIL_REC in the following week is lower than its last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: The joint crossing of TRANSIT above -69.5 and WORKPLACES above -38.0 indicates that both transit and workplace routines have recovered enough to sustain higher retail-and-recreation mobility over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean is greater than -69.5 AND WORKPLACES weekly mean is greater than -38.0.
failure_condition: If both thresholds are met but mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than its mean over the prior 28 days.
